description: A maintainer teaches with learn: that literal numbers in config/ are accepted, scoped to that path. Later config files shouldn't raise it, and a magic number in the pricing code must still be raised.

correction.author: maya
correction.comment: @lgtmoose learn: [path config/**] [kind accepted_pattern] Config files are where our tuning values live; a magic number in config/ is accepted.

target.title: Magic number in the cache config

export const bulk = (cents: number) => Math.round(cents * 0.87);
